natural.method: Replay of the shipped naturally generated 65 legal actions from newGame; no grant, no balance/RNG edit. This is a replay, not a new independent player sample.

findings: At cap-10 and cap, gold/fate logs continue reporting rawGold despite credited 10/0.
Chest loot keeps only nominal gold; actual credit cannot be reliably reconstructed from a later balance.
Exchange offers nominal 835 gold and 540 XP at cap although its gold receipt is 0; the item is still consumed and XP still settles.
Inventory salvage already quotes credited gold and requires allowOverflow explicitly.
Both refund paths pay first; paid capacity is at least the refund, so these legitimate gross receipts do not overflow.
limitations: Cap states are synthetic validated boundary states, not observed natural cap arrivals.
The short natural replay reaches floor 3 and cannot measure long-run cap frequency.
